body:
🔥 UNBENT FLAMES – Minecraft Survival Like Never Before 🔥
Where the elements awaken and the skies are never still ☁️🚀

Welcome to Unbent Flames, a unique Towny + Adventure + Elemental Bending survival server built for players who love building, exploring, conquering, and progressing together.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🌍 WHY JOIN UNBENT FLAMES?

🏘️ Build Nations & Rule the Skies
Create powerful towns, form alliances, and pilot flying ships using Towny + Movecraft.

🌊🔥🌪️🌱 Master Elemental Bending
Harness the elements and dominate battles with powerful bending abilities.

⚔️ Epic Adventures & Dangerous Mobs
Fight Elite Mobs, complete Adventurers Guild quests, and face powerful enemies.

🏰 Explore a Living World
Discover custom structures, hidden treasures, and a constantly evolving world.

💀 Death Isn’t the End
Protect your gear with Resurrection Chests and jump back into action fast.

⛏️ Automate Your Empire
Use Quarries for automated mining and resource gathering.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🧰 QUALITY OF LIFE & EXTRAS

📈 MCMMO Progression – Level up skills and grow stronger
💼 Jobs System – Earn money your way
🐾 MyPet Companions – Adventure with your own pet
🌲 TreeAssist – Faster, smoother tree cutting
🔐 Player Vaults – Secure storage for everyone
🎁 Reward Ads – Earn perks while supporting the server
🎤 Simple Voice Chat – Talk in-game with players
🗺️ BlueMap Live Map – View the world in real time

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
